_comment: Hand-checked list of Yellow's scripted gifts and events from Pallet Town to Cerulean. Every entry was read from the pokeyellow script lines in its 'source'; 'notes' record branches the fields don't capture. requires / requires_not: EVENT_* flags or {badge}, {badge_not}, {pikachu_happiness_at_least}, {item_in_bag}, {item_not_in_bag}, {pokedex_owned_less_than}, {money_at_least}, {player_facing}. sets / resets: EVENT_* (or {badge}). gives / takes: {item, count}, {pokemon, level}, {money}. battle: {class, trainer_no} = trainers.json parties[trainer_no-1]. wild_battle: the old man's scripted catch demo. trigger_coords: map tiles that start the event. texts: text.json ids in the order shown.

events.notes: CheckAndSetEvent sets the flag before GiveItem, so it is set even if the bag is full (then Route1PrintYoungster1Text.NoRoomText). Once set: Route1PrintYoungster1Text.AlsoGotPokeballsText.

Interacting with OAKSLAB_EEVEE_POKE_BALL after EVENT_OAK_ASKED_TO_CHOOSE_MON makes the rival take it: EEVEE, wRivalStarter = RIVAL_STARTER_JOLTEON (lines 218-243). The player is walked to Oak and given STARTER_PIKACHU (= PIKACHU) at level 5. Also sets wStatusFlags4 BIT_GOT_STARTER. Before choosing the ball: OaksLabEeveePokeBallText.Text.

Triggers when wYCoord == 6 after receiving Pikachu. End texts: IPickedTheWrongPokemon if the player wins, AmIGreatOrWhat if the player loses. The flag is set whatever the result and the party is healed. wRivalStarter becomes RIVAL_STARTER_FLAREON if the player won, else RIVAL_STARTER_VAPOREON (lines 370-381).

Runs automatically on the first entry. The player is walked left 1 and up 2, then gets the parcel; the map script moves on so it never repeats. Until EVENT_OAK_GOT_PARCEL, talking to the clerk shows ViridianMartClerkSayHiToOakText and there is no shop (ViridianMart_TextPointers vs ViridianMart_TextPointers2).

The Pokedex is not an item: it is EVENT_GOT_POKEDEX, and the Pokedex objects are hidden (TOGGLE_POKEDEX_1/2). No Poke Balls are given here. Side effects: Viridian City moves to its after-Pokedex script; TOGGLE_LYING_OLD_MAN hidden and TOGGLE_OLD_MAN_2 shown; TOGGLE_ROUTE_22_RIVAL_1 shown. With the rival battle done but no parcel: OaksLabOak1Text.YouShouldTalkToIt.

Yellow gives the 5 Poke Balls only after the Route 22 rival battle is won (line 836). With the Pokedex but not that win: OaksLabOak1Text.PokemonAroundTheWorldText. After the gift, with a Poke Ball in the bag, or with 2+ species owned: OaksLabOak1Text.ComeSeeMeSometimesText. Pallet Town then sets EVENT_PALLET_AFTER_GETTING_POKEBALLS(_2); after that Oak says OaksLabOak1Text.HowIsYourPokedexComingText and rates the Pokedex. The flag is set before GiveItem, so it is set even if the bag is full.

Before the Pokedex: BluesHouseDaisyRivalAtLabText. Bag full: BluesHouseDaisyBagFullText (flag not set). Afterwards: BluesHouseDaisyUseMapText. On success the Town Map object (TOGGLE_TOWN_MAP) is hidden.

Active until Oak gives the Pokedex (OaksLab.asm:587-589 moves Viridian City to its after-Pokedex script and hides this NPC, TOGGLE_LYING_OLD_MAN). Stepping on (19,9) or talking to him shows the text and pushes the player 1 step down.
After the Pokedex, stepping on (19,9) makes OLD_MAN2 face the player and speak; talking to him does the same. Afterwards he walks down 6 tiles and is hidden (TOGGLE_OLD_MAN_2).

This NPC starts hidden. Viridian Mart's script shows TOGGLE_OLD_MAN_1 once EVENT_COMPLETED_CATCH_TRAINING is set and sets EVENT_SPAWNED_OLD_MAN_1. Answering No: ViridianCityPrintOldManText.NotGoodEnoughForYouText.
Bag full: ViridianCityPrintFisherText.TM42NoRoomText (flag not set). After: ViridianCityPrintFisherText.TM42ExplanationText.

Flags are set when the Pokedex is given. Defeated = the player wins, Victory = the player loses. On a loss nothing is set and the battle can be retried. On a win wRivalStarter FLAREON becomes JOLTEON (lines 151-155) and the rival walks off. Beating Brock hides this rival and resets both trigger flags, so the battle can be missed for good.

Price is BCD $000050 = 50. No: Museum1FPrintScientist1Text.ComeAgainText and a push down. Not enough money: .DontHaveEnoughMoneyText then .ComeAgainText. Pewter City's default script resets EVENT_BOUGHT_MUSEUM_TICKET, so the ticket is bought on every visit.
On success the Old Amber object (MUSEUM1F_OLD_AMBER, TOGGLE_OLD_AMBER) is hidden. Bag full: .YouDontHaveSpaceText. After: .GetTheOldAmberCheckText.
The condition is EVENT_BEAT_BROCK, not the badge bit. He leads the player to the gym, walks right 5 and is hidden then re-shown (TOGGLE_GYM_GUY). Beating Brock hides him for good.

The badge is set even if the bag is full; then PewterGymTM34NoRoomText and talking to Brock later retries TM34. After TM34: PewterGymBrockText.PostBattleAdviceText. Also hides TOGGLE_GYM_GUY and TOGGLE_ROUTE_22_RIVAL_1.
Checks the BIT_BOULDERBADGE bit of wObtainedBadges. Without it the player is pushed 1 step down.
Sets the gate's map script to NOOP (no event flag).

After the win, with no fossil yet: MtMoonB2fSuperNerdEachTakeOneText; with a fossil: MtMoonB2FSuperNerdTheresAPokemonLabText. After the win, battles are disabled inside the fossil area (MtMoonB2F.asm:8-38).
Availability comes from the objects: the nerd blocks (13,8) until beaten. After Yes the nerd takes the Helix Fossil (TOGGLE_MT_MOON_B2F_FOSSIL_2 hidden). Bag full: MtMoonB2FYouHaveNoRoomText.Text.
Mirror of the Dome Fossil: the nerd takes the Dome Fossil (TOGGLE_MT_MOON_B2F_FOSSIL_1 hidden).

wCurOpponent = OPP_ROCKET, wTrainerNo = $2a (42). Jessie and James (MTMOONB2F_JESSIE and MTMOONB2F_JAMES) are shown and walk in. A loss resets the scripts and hides them; a win sets EVENT_BEAT_MT_MOON_3_JESSIE_JAMES after a fade-out. The same end text is used for win and loss.
Price is BCD 00 05 00 = 500. Money is taken only if GivePokemon succeeds. No: MagikarpSalesman.NoText. Not enough money: .NoMoneyText. Already bought: .NoRefundsText.
Defeated = the player wins, Victory = the player loses. On a loss the rival is hidden and the script cleared, so it retriggers. On a win: IWentToBills, then he walks off and is hidden.
The Rocket stands at (30,8) and triggers when the player is directly above or below him. On a win his text runs again at once, which gives TM28.

In Yellow TM28 comes from this Rocket, not from the trashed house; no flag records it. Success fades out, hides the Rocket (TOGGLE_CERULEAN_ROCKET), shows TOGGLE_CERULEAN_GUARD_1 and hides TOGGLE_CERULEAN_GUARD_2. Bag full: CeruleanCityRocketText.TM28NoRoomText and he stays. The trashed-house fishing guru only checks whether TM_DIG is in the bag (TheyStoleATMText without it, WhatsLostIsLostText with it) and gives nothing.
Bag full: CeruleanGymMistyTM11NoRoomText (the badge is still set) and talking to Misty later retries TM11. After: CeruleanGymMistyText.TM11ExplanationText.

ld a, [wPikachuHappiness] / cp 147 / jr c: 147 or more passes. Below 147 only CeruleanHouse1Text_1cfc8 is shown. Declining: CeruleanHouse1Text_1cfdf. If GivePokemon fails nothing is set. On success the Bulbasaur object is hidden (TOGGLE_CERULEAN_BULBASAUR). After: CeruleanHouse1Text_1cfd9.

The script does not check the five bridge trainers. The Nugget and EVENT_GOT_NUGGET come before the battle, so losing keeps it; EVENT_BEAT_ROUTE24_ROCKET is set only on a win. Bag full: .NoRoomText, EVENT_NUGGET_REWARD_AVAILABLE set, player pushed down. He is TOGGLE_NUGGET_BRIDGE_GUY; Route 25 hides him once EVENT_LEFT_BILLS_HOUSE_AFTER_HELPING is set.
No badge or Pikachu-happiness check: the only gate is EVENT_54F (unnamed in pokeyellow). Decline: Route24Text_515e9. After: Route24Text_515ee. If GivePokemon fails nothing is set.

No: BillsHousePrintBillPokemonText.NoYouGottaHelpText, then UseSeparationSystemText anyway. Bill-as-Pokemon walks into the cell separator and is hidden (TOGGLE_BILL_POKEMON). Route 25 resets EVENT_BILL_SAID_USE_CELL_SEPARATOR and re-shows him if the player leaves before meeting Bill.

The hidden event BillsHousePC at (1,4), facing up. Before the flag: BillsHouseMonitorText. Then Bill (BILLSHOUSE_BILL1) walks out and EVENT_MET_BILL_2 and EVENT_MET_BILL are set (BillsHouse.asm:135-209).

Shown automatically after Bill steps out and the player is walked right 3. Success also shows TOGGLE_CERULEAN_GUARD_1 and hides TOGGLE_CERULEAN_GUARD_2. Bag full: .SSTicketNoRoomText. Entering Route 25 afterwards sets EVENT_LEFT_BILLS_HOUSE_AFTER_HELPING and hides the Nugget Bridge Rocket and BILL1 (shows BILL2). The later Bill (BILLSHOUSE_BILL2) says BillsHousePrintBillCheckOutMyRarePokemonText.text.
